title: add_outline docstring claims plate top is 'flush at the fill's base' but flat fills hover 0.01 above it
evidence:
OUTLINE_H    = 0.02   # outline plate thickness
FILL_Z       = 0.03   # the flat fill plane (above the outline top)
...
def add_outline(name, fw, fd, cx=0.0, cy=0.0):
    """The MM thin-ink outline plate: a flat dark box OUTLINE_RING larger than
    the fill footprint, its top flush at the fill's base — visible as a thin
...
    add_cube(name + "_o", (cx, cy, OUTLINE_H / 2), (fw + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, fd + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, OUTLINE_H),
...
    add_flat_quad(name + "_roof", bw, bd, FILL_Z, fill_hex)
detail: Plate top is z=0.02; build_flat fills sit at FILL_Z=0.03 — the file's own FILL_Z comment says 'above the outline top', contradicting the 'flush' docstring. Only gable eaves (base_z=OUTLINE_H, line 280) are actually flush.
recommended_fix: Reword the add_outline docstring: plate top sits 0.01 below the flat fill plane (the hover avoids coplanar z-fighting); only the gable eaves rest flush on it.

title: Order pin (lint gate 7) omits the committed sprites.json 'order' array — the copy the renderer actually binds bboxes by
evidence:
GEN = ROOT / "tools" / "gen_sprites.py"
ODIN = ROOT / "app" / "render" / "sprites.odin"
--- app/render/sprites.odin:100,119 ---
	order, oko := obj["order"].(json.Array)
...
			sh.bboxes[i][k] = f32(n)
--- assets/sprites/sprites.json ---
 "order": [
  "house_0",
detail: Three copies of the order exist: files[], SPRITE_ORDER, and sprites.json 'order'. sprites_parse_boxes binds bboxes[i] positionally by the json order while textures bind to files[] — a hand-edited or stale json order (README says 'do not hand-edit', nothing enforces) mis-crops silently until T2.
recommended_fix: Extend test_sprite_order.py to also parse assets/sprites/sprites.json 'order' via json.load and assert equality with files[].
